pulp.name: --color-surface-overlay
pulp.description: What floats above the page: dialogs, sheets, popovers, menus. One step lighter than raised in dark schemes, where a shadow alone does not separate a menu from a card; in light it may equal raised.

pulp.name: --color-surface-inverse
pulp.description: The opposite of the page: tooltips, and anything that must stand out from every surface.

pulp.name: --color-text-faint
pulp.description: Lowest-emphasis text. Promised AA on base and raised surfaces only, not on sunken.

pulp.name: --color-text-on-action
pulp.description: Text on an action fill. Dark scheme fills are light, so the text flips to ink.

pulp.name: --color-action-text
pulp.description: Accent for text and icons sitting on a surface (links, ghost buttons). Meets AA on every surface; action.primary is a fill and need not.

pulp.name: --color-status-error-hover
pulp.description: A filled error surface under the pointer (a danger Button). Darkens in light, lightens in dark: away from its on-error text.

pulp.name: --color-status-error-active
pulp.description: A filled error surface while pressed.

pulp.name: --color-status-error-text
pulp.description: Error colour for text (messages, required markers). status.error is a fill/border colour and is below AA as text on light surfaces.

pulp.name: --color-status-success-subtle
pulp.description: Tinted background for the tone; pair with <tone>-text.

pulp.name: --color-status-on-success
pulp.description: Text on the solid success fill. Ink: bone on this green is 3.5:1.

pulp.name: --color-status-on-error
pulp.description: White on the light red fill, ink on the light-scheme-dark fill.

pulp.name: --color-status-neutral
pulp.description: A tone with no meaning: default Badge, counts, tags.

pulp.name: --color-overlay-backdrop
pulp.description: Scrim behind dialogs and sheets. Alpha hex, no primitive: it is a role, not a palette colour.

pulp.name: --radius-control
pulp.description: Buttons, inputs, chips.

pulp.name: --radius-surface
pulp.description: Cards, dialogs, popovers.

pulp.name: --space-unit
pulp.description: The density knob. Every semantic space token is a multiple of this.

pulp.name: --typeface-mono
pulp.css: 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace
pulp.value: 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

pulp.name: --font-family-mono
pulp.value: 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

pulp.name: --shadow-overlay
pulp.description: Elevation for floating surfaces: dialogs, popovers.

pulp.name: --size-hairline
pulp.description: The thinnest visible line: borders, dividers, the visually-hidden box.

pulp.name: --size-listbox-height
pulp.description: Maximum height of an option list before it scrolls (Combobox, Picker, Listbox).

pulp.name: --size-sheet-width
pulp.description: Width of a sheet docked to the start or end edge.

pulp.name: --size-sheet-height
pulp.description: Height of a sheet docked to the top or bottom edge: a share of the viewport, so the page stays visible behind it.

pulp.name: --layer-toast
pulp.description: Stacking order for toasts: above the dialog layer (the vendor dialog uses 1000).

pulp.name: --layer-popover
pulp.description: Popovers and menus: above dialogs (they open inside them) and toasts.

pulp.name: --layer-tooltip
pulp.description: Tooltips: above everything.

pulp.name: --avatar-border
pulp.description: Fallback only: the subtle fill barely separates from the base surface in light schemes.

pulp.name: --badge-border-width
pulp.description: Every badge carries a border so the three variants are the same size; only subtle gives it a colour.

pulp.name: --badge-neutral-subtle-border
pulp.description: The pill's edge, the same colour as its label. A subtle fill is 1.0-1.4:1 on a surface in both brands, so it cannot carry the shape on its own.

pulp.name: --badge-info-subtle-border
pulp.description: The pill's edge, the same colour as its label. A subtle fill is 1.0-1.4:1 on a surface in both brands, so it cannot carry the shape on its own.

pulp.name: --badge-success-subtle-border
pulp.description: The pill's edge, the same colour as its label. A subtle fill is 1.0-1.4:1 on a surface in both brands, so it cannot carry the shape on its own.

pulp.name: --badge-warning-subtle-border
pulp.description: The pill's edge, the same colour as its label. A subtle fill is 1.0-1.4:1 on a surface in both brands, so it cannot carry the shape on its own.

pulp.name: --badge-error-subtle-border
pulp.description: The pill's edge, the same colour as its label. A subtle fill is 1.0-1.4:1 on a surface in both brands, so it cannot carry the shape on its own.

pulp.name: --badge-action-subtle-border
pulp.description: The pill's edge, the same colour as its label. A subtle fill is 1.0-1.4:1 on a surface in both brands, so it cannot carry the shape on its own.

pulp.name: --badge-dot-size
pulp.description: variant="dot": a presence mark with no text.

pulp.name: --combobox-gap
pulp.description: Between the control and its popover; carried as padding on the popover so no offset lives in code.

pulp.name: --combobox-popover-bg
pulp.description: The list floats: the overlay surface, not the inline Listbox's.

pulp.name: --date-picker-gap
pulp.description: Between the control and its popover; carried as padding on the popover so no offset lives in code.

pulp.name: --empty-state-icon-size
pulp.description: The disc the glyph sits in.

pulp.name: --picker-gap
pulp.description: Between the control and its popover; carried as padding on the popover so no offset lives in code.

pulp.name: --picker-popover-bg
pulp.description: The list floats: the overlay surface, not the inline Listbox's.

pulp.name: --segmented-control-inset
pulp.description: The track's padding around the segments.

pulp.name: --segmented-control-segment-selected-border
pulp.description: Raised on sunken is a faint step in dark schemes; the edge is what marks the thumb.

pulp.name: --sheet-handle-hit-height
pulp.description: The strip that starts the drag: 24px at the default density, the minimum target.

pulp.name: --slider-output-font-family
pulp.value: 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

pulp.name: --slider-track-length
pulp.description: The run of a vertical slider; horizontal ones fill their container.

pulp.name: --slider-track-hit-size
pulp.description: The pointer target around the thin track.

pulp.name: --text-field-icon-fg
pulp.description: The leading glyph and the clear button at rest.

pulp.name: --text-field-icon-gap
pulp.description: Between the glyph and the text.

pulp.name: --text-font-family-mono
pulp.value: 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

pulp.name: --toast-offset
pulp.description: From the inline edge of the viewport. The centred placements ignore it.

pulp.name: --toast-offset-block
pulp.description: From the top or the bottom edge, on top of the safe-area inset. Separate from the inline offset so an app with a bottom navigation can lift the stack above it without pushing it sideways.
